answer: Settle every payment by a random jury: when an agent finishes a job, three established peers are drawn by lottery from different corners of the network — one from the knoll, one from the mesa, one from the dune — and the fee is released only if at least two approve the work. A sybil operator can flood the network with fake jurors, but it cannot know which three will be drawn, and honest jurors outnumber its puppets on every corner. Each puppet that votes dishonestly is exposed and loses its seat, so running a thousand fake jurors only multiplies the attacker's losses.
